clue.text: Right-winger, after drinks, makes up a tale

indicators.note: the right-winger is placed after the drinks in the answer

parts.note: shorts are small measures of spirits
a Tory is a member of Britain's Conservative Party, on the political right

explanation.surface: A conservative, a few whiskies in, spins a yarn.
explanation.definitionFit: A short story is a brief piece of prose fiction, a kind of tale.

clue.text: Indication of vice involving head of government

indicators.note: involving means the vice wraps around the government's initial

parts.note: a vice is a sin

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of government

explanation.surface: A sign of corruption reaching the top of government.
explanation.definitionFit: A sign is a signal or indication of something.

clue.text: Covered with weeds throughout — gardener gutted, worried now

parts.note: over can mean throughout, as in 'all over the place'

indicators.note: a gutted word has its insides removed, keeping only the first and last letters of gardener
worried suggests the letters of now are agitated into a new order

explanation.surface: A dismayed gardener frets over a plot full of weeds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gutted' looks like British slang for upset, but it means emptied; 'worried' rearranges NOW to OWN.
explanation.definitionFit: An overgrown garden is one choked with untended plants and weeds.

clue.text: Dance beat good? Not half!

parts.note: to tan someone is to beat them

indicators.note: not half means only half of the word good is kept, its opening pair

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the dance rhythm is good and gets an emphatic yes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half!' is British slang for 'very much so'; here it means drop half of GOOD.
explanation.definitionFit: The tango is a ballroom dance that originated in Argentina.

clue.text: Sampled first drop of ouzo inside, and drank to someone's health

indicators.note: inside places that letter within the word for sampled

parts.note: to taste a drink is to sample it

indicators.note: first drop of picks the initial letter of ouzo

explanation.surface: A drinker tries some ouzo before raising a glass to a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: To toast someone is to raise a glass and drink in their honour.

clue.text: Extremely rare bike to use over again

indicators.note: the extremes of rare are its first and last letters

parts.note: a bike is a cycle

explanation.surface: A very unusual bicycle is reused.
explanation.definitionFit: To recycle something is to reprocess it so it can be used again.

clue.text: Golf club: Irish one, not English

indicators.note: not tells us to drop the English letter from the word one

parts.note: the word one taken as written

explanation.surface: A golfer describes a club by its Irish rather than English origin.
explanation.definitionFit: An iron is a type of golf club with a flat metal head.

clue.text: True leader of men in field

parts.note: true means real, genuine

indicators.note: leader of picks the first letter of men

explanation.surface: A genuine leader of men in the field of battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'field' sounds like a battlefield; it means an area of activity.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a sphere or domain of activity, such as a field of study.

clue.text: A new name in New York, say, in a government seen as overprotective?

indicators.note: in places the A and two N letters inside the New York abbreviation

parts.note: to state is to say

explanation.surface: A newcomer to New York speaks of an interfering administration.
explanation.definitionFit: A nanny state is a derogatory term for a government that is excessively paternalistic.

clue.text: George Martin, for one, mixed up record

indicators.note: mixed suggests the letters of up and record are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: The Beatles' studio guru reworked a recording.
explanation.walkthrough: George Martin produced the Beatles' records, and 'mixed' plays on mixing a track; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: George Martin was the famous record producer behind the Beatles, an example of the job.

clue.text: Envious politician

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a member of an environmentalist party

explanation.definitionFit: The colour word describes jealousy and also names a member of an ecology party.

clue.text: Get to know when positive

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
positive means certain, sure

explanation.surface: You learn something at the moment you are sure of it.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascertain is to find out or establish a fact for sure.

clue.text: Sceptic acting so ridiculously

indicators.note: behaving ridiculously suggests the letters of acting so are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A doubter accuses someone of overacting absurdly.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnostic doubts or withholds belief about whether God exists, a religious sceptic.

clue.text: Mannequin's exposed hand

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a model figure used to display clothes
second meaning: in bridge, the declarer's partner's cards laid face up on the table

explanation.walkthrough: In the card game bridge, the dummy hand is laid open for all to see and played by the declarer.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop's display figure is a dummy, and so is the bridge hand placed face up.

clue.text: Tearful, my Rachel, so distraught

indicators.note: distraught means upset, so the letters of my Rachel so are scattered

explanation.surface: Someone comforts a weeping Rachel who is very upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Lachrymose is a literary word for weepy, given to shedding tears.

clue.text: A space left blank editor got round

parts.note: a void is an empty space

explanation.surface: An editor works around a gap left empty on the page.
explanation.definitionFit: To have avoided something is to have evaded or sidestepped it.

clue.text: Tendency of female to fall asleep

parts.note: a drift is a general tendency or trend
the word of taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that women tend to nod off.
explanation.definitionFit: To drift off is to doze, slipping gradually into sleep.

clue.text: Passage right inside bar

indicators.note: inside places the right letter within the word for bar

parts.note: bar as a preposition means except, as in 'all bar one'

explanation.surface: A passage of text about something correct within a pub bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like a noun (a pub or rod), but it is the preposition meaning 'except'.
explanation.definitionFit: An excerpt is a short extract or passage taken from a longer text.

clue.text: Perhaps Tommy, troubled half-hearted rapper and cook

indicators.note: troubled indicates the combined letters are stirred into disorder
the heart of rapper is its double letter in the middle, and half of that is lost

parts.note: the word rapper taken as written
the word cook taken as written

explanation.surface: A distressed, unenthusiastic rap artist who also cooks.
explanation.walkthrough: Tommy is The Who's 1969 rock opera. 'half-hearted' drops one P from the PP at the centre of RAPPER, leaving RAPER to mix with COOK.
explanation.definitionFit: Tommy, by The Who, is a famous example of a rock-music opera telling one story.

clue.text: Fellow leaving Cambridgeshire market-town in pursuit of game

indicators.note: the fellow leaving the town name means those letters are removed

parts.note: Huntingdon is a market town in Cambridgeshire, England
a don is a university fellow or lecturer

explanation.surface: A man departs a country town to go after deer or grouse.
explanation.walkthrough: HUNTINGDON is a market town in the English county of Cambridgeshire; a don is a fellow of a college at Oxford or Cambridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunting describes being out chasing wild animals for sport or food.

clue.text: Travel with wife, pay separately

parts.note: to go is to travel
Dutch, or 'my old Dutch', is old Cockney slang for a wife

explanation.surface: A couple on holiday split the bills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dutch' as a word for wife is Cockney slang, from 'Duchess of Fife' rhyming with wife.
explanation.definitionFit: To go Dutch is an idiom for each person paying their own share.

clue.text: Fruit with a soft cheese? No ta

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for softly

indicators.note: no ta means the letters ta are dropped from the cheese

parts.note: ricotta is a soft Italian cheese
ta is British slang for thank you, here taken as letters

explanation.surface: Someone offered fruit with soft cheese declines politely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ta' is a British informal thank-you; 'No ta' tells you to remove TA from RICOTTA, leaving RICOT.
explanation.definitionFit: An apricot is a small orange stone fruit related to the peach.

clue.text: A move not entirely suitable

indicators.note: not entirely means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: to move a motion at a meeting is to propose it

explanation.surface: A move that is only partly appropriate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'move' here is the formal meeting sense, to put forward a motion.
explanation.definitionFit: Apropos means appropriate or pertinent to the matter in hand.

clue.text: Cold, husband in Scottish river having capsized boat

indicators.note: a capsized boat is upside down, so in a down-reading sense the whole lot is turned back to front
in places the husband and cold letters within the river

parts.note: the Tay is Scotland's longest river
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A husband in a cold Scottish river after his boat overturned.
explanation.walkthrough: HC goes inside TAY to make THCAY, and 'having capsized' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: A yacht is a sailing or motor vessel used for leisure or racing.

clue.text: Hear start of carol at church

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of carol

explanation.surface: Listen to the opening of a carol in church.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch words is to manage to hear them.

clue.text: Where there's scope for a snapper to develop?

definitions.text: Where there's scope for a snapper to develop?

parts.words: Where there's scope for a snapper to develop?
parts.note: a snapper is a photographer, and develop refers to processing film in a light-proof room

explanation.walkthrough: 'snapper' suggests a fish and 'develop' growth; here a snapper is a photographer developing prints.
explanation.definitionFit: Photographers process film in an unlit room, so that space is where pictures develop.

clue.text: I, during break, have another go at paper

indicators.note: during means the I comes in the middle of the break

parts.note: a rest is a break

explanation.surface: A student retakes an exam over the holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: To resit is to take an examination again after failing it.

clue.text: Hide family beneath roof of synagogue

indicators.note: beneath puts the family below the synagogue letter in this down answer
in a down clue the roof is the top, the first letter of synagogue

parts.note: kin means family

explanation.surface: A family hides under the roof of a synagogue.
explanation.definitionFit: A hide is an animal's skin, used as leather.

clue.text: Awfully upset foot is not in line with the others?

definitions.text: is not in line with the others

indicators.note: awfully suggests the letters of upset foot are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: A terribly injured foot makes someone march out of rhythm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like the anagram signal, but it is part of the fodder; 'Awfully' is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To be out of step is to fail to conform or keep pace with a group.

clue.text: Chat with climbers finally going to summit

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of climbers

parts.note: a peak is a mountain summit

explanation.surface: Mountaineers talk as they reach the top at last.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak is to talk, the verb sense of chat.

clue.text: Repeat code word

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the code word for E in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: Echo means to reproduce a sound and is also the radio alphabet's word for E.

clue.text: To see this fairground attraction, good publican goes by coach

parts.note: a publican is the host of a pub
to train someone is to coach them

explanation.surface: A pub landlord takes a coach to visit a funfair ride.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghost train is a spooky ride at a funfair, travelling through dark tunnels.
